notes:
2026-09-16 (engine-lane primitive build, re-diagnosis — the 'no mechanism grants a whole new triggered ability to another permanent' framing this file's own prior notes repeatedly confirmed is now PARTIALLY WRONG, not just re-confirmed): built a real, narrow `Trigger.on: 'equippedAttacks'` primitive (card.ts + engine.ts's widened `fireOnAttackTriggers`) that DOES close 'an Equipment granting a trigger to its equipped creature' for real, for the 'whenever equipped creature ATTACKS' family — see white-mage-s-staff's own progress.json for the full writeup, and ENGINE_GAPS.md's own updated entry. This card's OWN granted ability does NOT belong to that family, though — its real Forge trigger occasions are `Mode$ SpellCast` ('whenever you cast a noncreature spell') and `Mode$ Drawn` ('whenever you draw your Nth card each turn'), checked directly against `res/cardsfolder/a/astrologians_planisphere.txt`. Neither has ANY `Trigger.on` auto-fire dispatch anywhere in this engine, for ANY card, granted or native — genuinely different, much bigger, still-unbuilt trigger families (17+ real pool cards share the 'cast a noncreature spell' one alone — sahagin, tellah-great-sage, queen-brahne's own Prowess, the-prima-vista, prompto-argentum, shambling-cie-th, red-mage-s-rapier — another Equipment with this exact granted shape — among others; several also need real 'mana spent casting that spell' magnitude tracking this engine doesn't have either, per sahagin's own definition.ts comment). Building `'castNoncreatureSpell'`/`'drawNthCardThisTurn'` auto-fire dispatch (+ mana-spent tracking) is real, worthwhile, genuinely out of this narrow pass's own scope — DECLINED here with this corrected, more precise reason (not the original 'no grant mechanism' diagnosis, which is now stale for the attacks-family but still accurate for THIS card's own real trigger occasions). No file changes made to this card (definition.ts/synergy.json unchanged, review stays 'ai').

2026-09-16 (AI-fact-elimination sweep, fin/46, re-examined per this task's own standing 'try hard before declaring bespoke' instruction): re-ran `apply-recognizers.mjs astrologian-s-planisphere` (0 new facts). Re-checked the 1 remaining unprovenanced fact (`{event:'putCounter', counterType:'+1/+1', target:{equippedBySelf:true}}`) against (1) the recognizer catalog — no recognizer reads a GRANTED trigger+effect pair on another permanent (this consequence occurs on the EQUIPPED creature's own future cast/draw actions, never on this card's own definition.ts triggers/effects, so there's nothing for any recognizer to walk); (2) `card.ts`'s real `Effect`/`Actions` surface, re-read fresh — confirmed no vocabulary exists for granting a whole new triggered ability (condition+effect pair) to another permanent, only keyword/P&T/type broadcasts; (3) `ENGINE_GAPS.md`'s own already-tracked list (line ~314) — this EXACT gap, same class as `white-mage-s-staff`'s own case checked in this same sweep, is already named there for 4 cards. Conclusion unchanged: genuinely bespoke pending new engine-core vocabulary, not closable by a recognizer or a definition.ts fix today. No file changes made (definition.ts/synergy.json unchanged, review stays 'ai').

2026-09-16 (fin/26-50 re-triage): re-verified fresh, 0 hard failures. 1 AI fact remains (granted put-counter trigger via equip) — already the named, generalized `isEquipGrantedPutCounterFact` exemption in verify-synergy.mjs (paired explicitly with white-mage-s-staff's own case in that same comment block). Genuinely bespoke, no new gap.

2026-09-13 (real cast-lifecycle fix, the fin/28 (paladin-s-arms) regression the user directly reported: "should have been cast, onEnter trigger doesn't magically trigger"): this card was the one sibling that never even got the 2026-09-12 'chain into one continuous story' retrofit — it still had TWO separate scenarios, a bare `trigger:'onEnter'` (the exact "mythical enter" shortcut dragoon-s-lance's own sibling regression documents: starts `self` already on the Battlefield, skips `cast`/`enters` outright) plus a second bare-activate scenario relying on `harness.ts`'s automatic top-level `activate`. Consolidated to ONE scenario using the same real fix dragoon-s-lance/paladin-s-arms now use: `Scenario.forceCast: true` (harness.ts) forces a genuine `cast`(Hand)->`enters`(Battlefield) lifecycle despite this card's own `activationCost` (Equip {2}), then `sequence: ['onEnter', {activate: true}]` fires the real Job select ETB trigger and the real Equip {2} activation in one continuous playthrough (`you: {creaturesCount: 1}`, same 'other real creature already on the battlefield' shape every sibling uses, preserving the real `read:getCreaturesInPlay` evidence the old second scenario provided). `review` stays 'ai' (no reset needed, was already ai). Regenerated trace.json (`run-scenarios.mjs --slug=astrologian-s-planisphere`) — confirmed real `cast`/`enters` log lines now present. verify-synergy.mjs scoped: OK.

2026-09-12 (ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #14's own remaining sub-gap, closed for real): the 'is a Wizard' type-grant half is no longer honest-but-structurally-inert — `definition.ts` gained `continuousTypeGrants: [{types:['Wizard'], includeSelf:false, equippedBySelf:true}]` (`card.ts`'s new sibling field to `continuousKeywordGrants`, read live by `state.ts`'s new `effectiveSubtypes`/`hasSubtype`). The granted 'put a +1/+1 counter...' ability is UNAFFECTED — still its own, genuinely different, still-open gap class (`isEquipGrantedPutCounterFact`, unchanged). This card's own grantType fact still has no achievable trace evidence (2 plain harness.ts Scenario[] entries, no manual-log-injection field) — now covered by verify-synergy.mjs's shape-scoped `isEquippedTypeGrantFact` (replacing the old per-name `card.name === "Astrologian's Planisphere" && p.event === 'grantType'` line). `review` was already 'ai' (no reset needed). verify-synergy.mjs scoped: OK. Regenerated trace.json (`run-scenarios.mjs --slug=astrologian-s-planisphere`) — unchanged shape.

2026-09-12 (earlier): Migrated to unified Fact model. Verified real oracle text against data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #46 first — the dispatch's own paraphrase ("choose Wizard or Time Mage") was wrong; real 'Job select' is reminder text for a deterministic ETB (create a 1/1 Hero token, then attach), not a modal choice, same mechanic as dragoon-s-lance/paladin-s-arms/machinist-s-arsenal/white-mage-s-staff. Removed a real mismodel from the pre-migration draft: the granted 'put a +1/+1 counter on this creature' ability was engine-modeled as two fabricated onEquippedCastsNoncreatureSpell/onEquippedDrawsThirdCardThisTurn triggers on the Equipment itself with target:'self' — that puts the counter on the Equipment, not the equipped creature the real text means by "this creature". Removed the fabricated triggers/scenarios; the granted ability is now an honest putCounter source fact (target:{equippedBySelf:true}), same gap class as White Mage's Staff's own granted lifegain ability (verify-synergy.mjs's isWhiteMagesStaffGrantedAbilityFact) — no Effect/Actions surface grants a new triggered ability to another permanent. Added a new, shape-generalized exemption (isEquipGrantedPutCounterFact, verify-synergy.mjs) since this is the 2nd real card hitting this exact wall. Did NOT run compute-weights.mjs (kept -1 placeholders on facts with no real trace magnitude) — same as every sibling Job-select Equipment (dragoon-s-lance/machinist-s-arsenal/paladin-s-arms/white-mage-s-staff) already left as-is.
knownGaps: granted ability ('whenever you cast a noncreature spell and whenever you draw your third card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature') is a whole NEW triggered ability granted to the equipped creature — no engine Effect/Actions surface exists for granting a fresh trigger+effect to another permanent (continuousKeywordGrants/continuousPTGrants/continuousTypeGrants only ever broadcast a keyword/P&T delta/subtype, never a fresh condition+effect pair). Modeled as an honest, oracle-anchored putCounter fact with no trace evidence, exempted by shape in verify-synergy.mjs (isEquipGrantedPutCounterFact) — same gap class as White Mage's Staff (fin/42). Still open, unaffected by the 2026-09-12 type-grant closure above.

2026-09-12 (gap #14 fully closed): 'is a Wizard in addition to its other types' is now real, executable machinery (continuousTypeGrants) — no longer a gap. Only the EVIDENCE half stays open (plain harness.ts Scenario[] style, no manual-read injection possible).
